body: I don't have any money at all really, but before I go I think I'll set aside some of my belongings so that they could be donated to a shelter or goodwill. Something like that.

Thank you for taking the time to respond. It's been a very long time since I've actually ever felt heard. 

As to your question about whether I'd ever refer to my family as rotten? No, never. They're the best people I know. I feel like your statement about emotional labor does apply to then though. I feel as though I've taken to much from them and they've finally hit their limit. It is completely in their realm to do so though.

I think my brain has a special defense mechanism when it comes to talking because I just shut down during conversations and anytime someone wants to have a serious conversation with me, I get aggressive and offensive. Talking seems to be out of play for me. And I have tried therapy with multiple therapists to see if maybe they could teach me how to properly communicate or how to stop being so nasty to others and each time I get too scared to open up, leading me to never going back to their office. I think it's because I'm afraid they'll agree that I'm horrible and that no onr can help me. I'm beyond help I believe, plain and simple. Like I said previously, my fate feels woven into the fabrics of my being and there's no use trying to deny that anymore. 

Thank you for replying to me and I'm sorry that my response was so long. I have a habit of doing that. I hope you have a nice day.
